out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CDI: CFM showed up during inspection. CFM stated one of the chefs will be taking the CFM exam in a few weeks via corporate wide exam.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink neat the 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PIC placed paper towels at hand sink.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: uncooked frozen salmon filet thawing above RTW blue cheese crumble and container of sauces inside the Asber 2 Dr prep top refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated salmon to bottom shelf inside the Asber 2 Dr preptop refrigerator.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed uncooked frozen salmon filet improperly thawing in uncut ROP packaging inside the Asber 2 Dr preptop refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: EHS instructed PIC to cut ROP packaging of the uncooked frozen salmon filet to allow for proper thawing. HILTON GARDEN INN TYSONS (Inspection Date: 05/01/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed 2 ice bins that have been cleaned not stored covered or inverted near 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM will reorder hangers to store ice bin inverted. CFM will invert ice bins on clean food contact surface in meantime.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: Observed no high temperature thermometer available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. CDI: CFM odered high temperature dish thermometer during inspection.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed salmon improperly thawing in uncut vacuum packaging inside Delfield 2 Dr stacked reach in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: CDI: CFM cut and removed salmon from vacuum packaging.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items (slicer under Ecolab bug light) that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. EHS advised CFM to remove slicer if no longer using for operation.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Holding Temps
violations.observation: Employees are not routinely monitoring the temperatures of Time/Temperature Control for Safety foods during hot and cold holding.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or Certified Food Manager shall designate employees to monitor the cold holding and hot holding of time/temperature control for safety foods. The employees shall be trained in using a calibrated food thermometer to ensure proper temperatures. CFM will train staff on food safety and implement temperature monitoring procedures prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CFM trained staff and completed the documentation for each food employee.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided written instructions.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at dishmachine is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Observed handsink hot water at 70F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Please provide hot water (and cold water) at adequate pressure prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025.

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated:moldy limes, moldy honeydew, curdled half’n’half in a carafe, 4 containers of whipped cream cheese with a best by date in May 2024 in the WIC.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. CFM discarded food and trained staff.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served raw or partially cooked were observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3): vacuum packaged raw salmon.
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish. Please provide a supplier letter. CFM contacted the supplier for the letter. Reinspection is scheduled for 5/23/2025.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken stored over liquid eggs, raw ground beef stored over jalepenos in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved the food and trained staff. HILTON GARDEN INN TYSONS (Inspection Date: 05/16/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required: ice machine interior and juice and coffee dispenser nozzles.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. CFM cleaned the juice nozzles and will implement a cleaning schedule for the ice machine.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut cantaloupe at 52F, cheddar at 52F, marinara at 51F, yogurt at 50F, feta at 52F, mozzarella at 51F, Gouda at 51F, salsa at 51F, cooked beef at 50F, raw ground beef at 53F, scrambled egg mix at 49F, arugula at 54F, mixed greens at 60F, cream cheese at 52F, milk at 50F, half’n’half at 52F, almond milk at 52F; liquid egg at cook line at 77F; cream cheese on ice at juice machine at 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded food and trained staff.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: ham, feta cheese
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. CFM discarded food and trained staff.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: salmon, beef
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Please update the menu with a disclosure statement prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed vacuum packed fish thawed in 2DR Stacked Delfield without the package being opened.
violations.corrective_action: CFM discarded the food. Please open all ROP packages of fish when thawing.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers Accuracy, Degrees C & F
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device is not accurate in degrees F. Food thermometer read 44F when calibrated in ice water.
violations.corrective_action: Food temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Celsius or dually scaled in Celsius and Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/- 1 degree C in the intended range of use. CFM will purchase another food thermometer prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Clean and Dry Location
violations.observation: Food stored in a wet or soiled location as follows: food in WIC subject to splash contamination from dripping condenser unit and condensation on the fan that is sprayed while the fan is in operation in the WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location. Please repair the WIC prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025. HILTON GARDEN INN TYSONS (Inspection Date: 05/16/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean metal food pans, glasses, coffee dispensers were found stored in the mechanical room.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. CFM will store all items in another location prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025.

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Plastic bins and beverage dispensers were found stored while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization above the prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. Discussed with CFM. Please consider storing equipment in another location to dry to prevent providing a water source for pests prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) Lactic acid dispenser at 3 compartment sink is dispensing at 452ppm. 2) Condenser unit is leaking in the WIC and there is also condensation on the WIC fan. 3) There is a pool of water on the bottom of the 2DR Stacked Delfield cooler. 4) Gasket on 2DR Stacked Delfield is in poor repair.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please repair all items prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Please purchase prior to reinspection on 5/25/2025.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the mop sink is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. There are two hoses attached at the mop sink with a splitter that is not a pressure bleeding device.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. Please remove one hose or replace the splitter with one that is designed for two hoses prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the handsink at dishmachine piping are leaking. The drains under the prep sink and under the dump sink next the Alto-Shaam are not being cleaned and maintained.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Please repair the leak and clean the drains prior to reinspection on 5/23/2025.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse container was uncovered.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. CFM will train staff.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: The bottom storage shelving side the two-tier refrigerator and freezer on the cookline are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The hot water temperature at the some of the hand washing sinks an and tan. The 3-vat sinks fluctuate from 89 to 115F.
violations.corrective_action: Adjust the plumbing system to provide consistent hot water that meet the minimum required hot water temperatures at all sinks.
